summary.text: Buck Newton is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 4 since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he previously served in the Senate from 2011 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Buck Newton, whose full name is Eldon Sharpe Newton III, was born in Wilson, North Carolina, and graduated from Hunt High School.

He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Appalachian State University and a J.D. from Campbell University School of Law, and his career experience includes working as an attorney in private practice and owning a small business.
Newton served in the North Carolina State Senate representing District 11 from 2011 to 2017, and assumed office in District 4 on January 1, 2023.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Appropriations/Base Budget and Judiciary committees and as a member of the Education/Higher Education, Finance and Transportation committees.
